name: LUYTEN PLATYPUS X12
summary: Flagship mobile crane-type 3D concrete printer from Melbourne, Australia: unfolds in about 20 minutes to a 12 m wide, 6 m high printing frame of customisable length and prints whole houses or structural shells on site.

germany.statusNote: Sold by enquiry from the Australian maker; it lists sales countries such as the UK, Japan, Turkey, the UAE and the USA but no Germany or EU country, and no EU distributor or CE statement was found. No price on the page.
